name: Design System & Shared Components
description: Design System & Shared Components standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-DS applies.

rules.title: Use shared design tokens for visual primitives
rules.detail: Color, typography, spacing, radius, elevation and motion values come from versioned tokens rather than scattered literals.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use shared design tokens for visual primitives.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use shared design tokens for visual primitives.

rules.title: Create components from repeated interaction patterns
rules.detail: Shared components expose stable variants and states and avoid feature-specific business logic.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Create components from repeated interaction patterns.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Create components from repeated interaction patterns.

rules.title: Define accessibility as part of each component contract
rules.detail: Keyboard/focus, labels, roles, disabled/error states and contrast requirements are built into shared components.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define accessibility as part of each component contract.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define accessibility as part of each component contract.

rules.title: Document component API, states and examples
rules.detail: Each reusable component describes intended use, props/inputs, variants, state behavior and anti-patterns.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Document component API, states and examples.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Document component API, states and examples.

rules.title: Version breaking component changes
rules.detail: Breaking visual/behavior/API changes require migration guidance and coordinated adoption.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Version breaking component changes.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Version breaking component changes.

rules.title: Avoid local forks without a convergence plan
rules.detail: Feature teams extend shared components through supported APIs or contribute improvements rather than copying divergent versions.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Avoid local forks without a convergence plan.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Avoid local forks without a convergence plan.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-DS applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Design System & Shared Components to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Design System & Shared Components is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Design System & Shared Components failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
